instruction: Add win/loss sparklines to the "Chart" column for each order ID, comparing each month's value to the previous month.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating win/loss sparklines (specialized sparkline type showing positive/negative changes) for each order ID. This is infeasible because: (1) LibreOffice Calc lacks native win/loss sparkline functionality, (2) even if created through custom methods, the graphical representation cannot be programmatically verified to confirm correct win/loss visualization logic, and (3) verifying that each sparkline correctly compares month-to-month values is beyond current evaluator capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function for a task that cannot be programmatically verified
The metadata explanation provides accurate and well-reasoned justification: LibreOffice Calc lacks native win/loss sparkline functionality
Verification challenge is legitimate: graphical sparkline representations cannot be reliably validated through code-based evaluators
The semantic judgment is correct: month-to-month comparison logic in visual sparklines is beyond current evaluator capabilities without image analysis
Using 'infeasible' is the appropriate and honest evaluation approach for tasks requiring visual verification of graphical elements
